subject: Creativity
title: The Right-Brain Myth: Creativity Isn't One-Sided
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Right-Brain Myth: Creativity Isn't One-Sided usable.

hook.text: 'Left brain = logical, right brain = creative.' Popular, catchy, and completely false.

buildup.text: Sperry's split-brain research showed some specialization, not separate creative and logical selves.

discovery.text: Brain scans show creative tasks recruit both hemispheres. No one is simply 'left-brained' or 'right-brained.'

twist.text: Creative thinking actually requires INTENSE communication between both hemispheres.

climax.text: The myth is harmful: people told they're 'left-brained' believe they can't be creative.

punchline.text: You're not left-brained or right-brained. You're whole-brained. Use it all.

quiz.question: What did a 2013 University of Utah brain scan study find?
options: People are clearly left or right-brained
No evidence of people being dominantly left or right-brained
Only artists use the right brain
